issue.title: bob plugins sync keeps refusing dirty agent deploys after their content is committed to master
issue.description:
Agents that change bob-plugins run `bob plugins sync` from their linked checkout as the
repo's AGENTS.md requires, but SASE commits their edits only after the turn ends. Every
such deploy therefore stamps `.bob-deploy.json` with `"dirty": "dirty"` and the agent
workspace's `source_root`. From then on, every later sync from any other checkout
(including the default clean master checkout) refuses that plugin ("deployed from
uncommitted build ... HEAD ancestry cannot prove inclusion"). The refusal persists after
the dirty content is committed and merged, so it outlives the edit that caused it.

Observed instances (each needed a land agent to prove inclusion by hand and force-sync):
- bob-cli-e4: bob-navigation-hotkeys and task-status-cycler (bob-cli_12, then bob-cli_16).
  This recurred on 2026-11-02 from bob-cli_21 at 7dbbb6d (+1 recorded on bob-cli-e4).
- bob-cli-fd.2 and bob-cli-ey.6 phase notes: sync refused because another workspace had an uncommitted build.
- bob-cli-fl.6.1.4 and bob-cli-fl.6.1.5: bob-ledger-tools refused. The vault holds a dirty
  bob-cli_14 build on 3bab3c0 (2026-11-02T11:43Z). The bob-cli-fl.6.1 land agent showed its
  `styles.css` equals commit 3a2b03b and its `main.js` equals 3a2b03b's minus the
  concurrently landed 7a647e8. The content was on master hours later, but sync still refused.

Possible remediation (needs design): treat a dirty deploy as included when its recorded
managed-file hashes match blobs reachable from the source HEAD, or when every
differing hunk is accounted for by later commits. Alternatively, have SASE's post-turn
commit re-stamp the deploy provenance. Whatever the fix, the protection from bob-cli-cu
must not overwrite a genuinely uncommitted build.

task_type_fields.impact: Vault plugins silently stay stale after landed work (Bryan runs old builds) until a land agent force-syncs; every multi-agent plugin epic pays manual provenance proofs.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/plugins/deploy.rs (dirty-deploy provenance refusal) + agent sync-before-commit workflow
task_type_fields.repro:
1. In a SASE agent workspace, edit a bob-plugins fragment in the linked checkout, run `npm run build` and `bob plugins sync` (stamp records dirty + that workspace's source_root).
2. Let SASE commit and push the edit after the turn.
3. From any other checkout (for example `bob plugins sync -n` using the default /home/bryan/projects/github/bobs-org/bob-plugins on master), observe `refusing to overwrite plugin <id> deployed from uncommitted build at <other workspace>` even though master contains the content.
Live on apollo 2026-11-02: `bob plugins sync -n` refuses bob-ledger-tools (bob-cli_14 @3bab3c0), bob-navigation-hotkeys and task-status-cycler (bob-cli_21 @7dbbb6d).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-fl.6.1.5 note #2 proposed resolving its blocked bob-ledger-tools sync, and the bob-cli-fl.6.1 land agent found the same refusal recurring across many epics. Each instance needed a hand-proved force sync, so the per-instance reconcile in bob-cli-e4 does not address the cause.
